cohort: Participants from two previous trials on EFM vs. IA during labor ('Dublin trial' and 'Vintzileos trial')
finding: Re-evaluation of two previous trials using the National Institute of Child Health and Human Development (NICHHD) guidelines for electronic fetal heart monitoring (EFM) showed no significant difference in cesarean section rates, operative delivery rates, or rates of non-reassuring fetal heart rate patterns between EFM and intermittent auscultation (IA) groups.
mod_finding: The comparison of the recalculated cesarean section and operative delivery rates for fetal distress between EFM and IA group were no longer statistically significant, both in the Dublin trial and Vintzileos trial.
